title: What If Your Car Rolled Into a Lake?
lines: Your car just rolled into a lake.
It floats for about a minute.
Or wait for the car to fill up,
Faster than you dodge aunties asking,
Power windows usually still work at first.
Stuck? Smash a side window, near the corner.
Keep a window breaker within reach.
Not in the dikki, under Mummy's pickle jars.
Who needs to see this? Tag them!

post.instagram:
Your car rolls into a lake. You have about one minute to get out 🚗

Waiting for it to fill up so you can open the door? Myth. Remember SWCO: Seatbelt off, Window open, Children out (oldest first), Out. And keep a window breaker within reach, not in the dikki under Mummy's pickle jars.

Did you know these 4 letters before today? Comment YES or NO.

post.youtube_title: Car Sinking in a Lake? Do This in the First Minute 🚗 #shorts
post.youtube_description:
A car that rolls into water floats for about a minute, and that is your time to get out. Waiting for it to fill up so you can open the door is a myth: water pressure jams the door. Remember SWCO: Seatbelt off, Window open (power windows usually still work at first, or smash a side window near the corner), Children out oldest first, then Out, and call 112 once you're safe.
